description: This file contains core service functions for managing projects within a collaborative platform, including project creation, listing, access control, updating, deletion, and member management. It leverages SQLAlchemy for database interactions and integrates with an activity recording system.

methods.name: Project _ensure_project_access(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, user_id: int)
methods.description: Verifies if a user has access to a project (owner or member) and retrieves the project.

methods.name: Project create_project(db: AsyncSession, owner: User, name: str, description: Optional[str], visibility: str)
methods.description: Creates a new project and assigns the owner with an initial activity record.

methods.name: List[Project] list_projects_for_user(db: AsyncSession, user_id: int)
methods.description: Lists all projects that a user owns or is a member of.

methods.name: Project get_project_detail(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, user_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific project if the user has access.

methods.name: Project update_project(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, user_id: int, updates: dict)
methods.description: Updates project fields if the user is the owner or has sufficient admin role, with activity logging.

methods.name: None delete_project(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, user_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a project if the user is the owner.

methods.name: ProjectMember add_or_update_member(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, actor_id: int, target_user_id: int, role: str)
methods.description: Adds a new member or updates an existing member's role within a project, with role-based access control.

methods.name: None remove_member(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, actor_id: int, target_user_id: int)
methods.description: Removes a member from a project, ensuring owner cannot be removed and only authorized users can perform removal.
